def render_list(renderer: 'BaseRenderer', token: Dict[str, Any], state:
    'BlockState') ->str:
    attrs = token.get('attrs', {})
    if attrs.get('ordered'):
        children = _render_ordered_list(renderer, token, state)
    else:
        children = _render_unordered_list(renderer, token, state)
    
    text = ''.join(children)
    parent = token.get('parent')
    if parent:
        if parent.get('tight'):
            return text
        return text + '\n'
    return strip_end(text) + '\n'

def _render_list_item(renderer: 'BaseRenderer', parent: Dict[str, Any],
    item: Dict[str, Any], state: 'BlockState') ->str:
    leading = parent['leading']
    tight = parent['tight']
    
    lines = []
    children = item.get('children', [])
    for index, child in enumerate(children):
        child = cast(Dict[str, Any], child)
        if child['type'] == 'list':
            child['parent'] = parent
            text = render_list(renderer, child, state)
        else:
            text = renderer.render_token(child, state)
        
        if index == 0:
            text = strip_end(text)
            indent = ' ' * len(leading)
            lines.append(leading + text.replace('\n', '\n' + indent))
        else:
            text = strip_end(text)
            indent = ' ' * len(leading)
            lines.append(indent + text.replace('\n', '\n' + indent))
    
    if tight:
        return '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
    else:
        return '\n\n'.join(lines) + '\n'

def _render_unordered_list(renderer: 'BaseRenderer', token: Dict[str, Any],
    state: 'BlockState') ->Iterable[str]:
    attrs = token.get('attrs', {})
    bullet = attrs.get('bullet', token.get('bullet', '-'))
    tight = attrs.get('tight', token.get('tight', True))
    for item in token['children']:
        leading = bullet + ' '
        parent = {
            'leading': leading,
            'tight': tight,
        }
        yield _render_list_item(renderer, parent, item, state)
